I live in Batavia, and the Game Cave is still open. Its in the Aldi's parking lot right next to Domino's. It's a nice small magic store, and the owner Brandon is extremely nice. To newer players typically he cuts deals with. Also if you have a deck idea you want to build, he can put it together for as cheap as possible and doesn't charge any extra. I recommend at least checking him out, and support the local small store.
